query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "User" agent
                JOIN team_user member ON member.user_id = agent.id
                JOIN team_user manager
                    ON manager.team_id = member.team_id
                   AND manager.user_id = $1
                WHERE agent.id = $2
                  AND agent."isAgent"
                  AND manager.team_role IN ('owner', 'admin')
            ) AS "manages!"
